To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the LSTAR-LGARCH and LSTAR-LST-LGARCH type neural network models provide important gains for modeling and forecasting volatility of crude oil returns.
LSTAR-LST-MLP-GARCH and LSTAR-LST-RBF-GARCH models are superior to the baseline GARCH models in terms of forecasting capabilities.
the nonlinear LSTAR-LST models augmented with MLP and/or RBF neural networks provide important gains over single regime GARCH models, in terms of modeling volatility in crude oil price returns.
In summary, our research is concerned with
modeling and forecasting volatility of crude oil prices using a class of nonlinear econometrics models.
the modeling and forecasting of the volatility of crude oil prices using a class of nonlinear GARCH models augmented with neural networks.
the modeling and forecasting of oil prices with a new class of models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LSTAR-LSTM-GARCH models augmented with neural networks provide superior forecasting capabilities in comparison to the single-regime GARCH models.
the LSTAR-GARCH models augmented with MLP and/or RBF neural networks provide important gains over traditional GARCH models and other LSTAR based models.
the LSTAR-LSTM-RBF and MLP type models are the best performing models in modeling and forecasting volatility for crude oil prices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LSTAR-LSTD-GARCH-NN models are superior to the baseline models and the LSTAR-LSTM-GARCH models.
the models proposed in this study are capable of providing more accurate forecasts of oil prices.
the LSTAR and LST type models provide a useful framework for modeling the nonlinearities in the conditional mean process of crude oil prices and their returns.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nonlinear models provide important gains for the modeling and forecasting of the volatility in the oil prices.
nonlinear models augmented with neural network components are able to capture nonlinearities in the conditional volatility of crude oil prices, and hence provide more accurate forecasts.
the LSTAR-LSTM-GARCH-RBF type neural network models could be utilized for forecasting volatility in crude and other oil prices.
